{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check their converted status
print(f'QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'QA orders converted status: {qa_orders["converted"].unique().tolist()}')

# Check if they are part of any segment
print(f'QA orders by customer_segment: {qa_orders["customer_segment"].value_counts().to_dict()}')"}
